与城市生活一起成长(Growing up with city life): 一篇关于城市生活的B1记叙文:格蕾丝的经历、感受与成长。

Grace believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Grace wrote down every idea in a small notebook. The bypass removed trucks from town.
Grace's dream job is to be a nurse. Jack always says that small steps matter more than big plans. The corner store looked quieter than usual that evening. Also, the boutique stocks local designers.

There are always more possibilities than we expect. Jack and Grace are preparing a report about the corner store. People around Grace often share different ideas about the corner store. Best of all, relaxed fit returns every decade.
Little by little, things began to change. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. On Thursday evenings, Grace reviews the notes from class. Cyclists shouldn't ride on the pavement.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. The subway station has become an important part of daily life. Grace is saving money to buy a ticket to London.
